speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: What if the Packers were actual meat packers...

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: and the Steelers were actual steelworkers?

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: In Green Bay, jerseys rip off. Hairnets go on.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Fun fact. The Packers are named after a meat packing company.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: In nineteen nineteen, it paid for their first jerseys.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: So Green Bay is just going back to work.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Now Pittsburgh. Hard hats. Molten steel, over two thousand degrees.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: And they started as the Pittsburgh Pirates.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: In nineteen forty, fans renamed them in a newspaper contest.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Pirates became Steelers. Arrr became clang.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: One field. One football. Zero rules.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Round one. Trophies.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Pittsburgh rolls out six Super Bowl wins. Tied for the most ever.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Green Bay answers with a forklift. Thirteen league titles. Most in NFL history.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Round two. Defense.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Pittsburgh drops an actual Steel Curtain.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Fans named that defense too. Radio contest, nineteen seventy-one.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Sausages bounce off. Cheese bounces off. Forklift? Bounces off.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: But Green Bay has one move nobody else in the league has.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: The fans own the team. Shareholders since nineteen twenty-three.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: And owners vote.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Motion to scrap the curtain. All in favor?

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Every cheesehead goes up.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Motion passed. The Steel Curtain gets sold for scrap.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Pittsburgh fires back. Every fan whips out a Terrible Towel.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: A radio guy invented it in nineteen seventy-five.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Green Bay answers with the cheesehead.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Invented in nineteen eighty-seven... out of a couch cushion.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: So Pittsburgh fans name everything. Green Bay fans own everything.

speaker: NARRATOR
spoken_text: Steel or sausage? Comment who wins.
